eight_by_eight_call_ended_trigger.description: Runs when a voice call made through your voice subaccount ends, however it ended. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.callCount: How many call legs it had
output.details: Each call leg (callA and so on): numbers, direction, status, duration and quality
output.errorDetails: What went wrong, for an error: errorMsg and errorCode
output.lastAction: The last step of the call, such as SAY or PLAY_FILE
output.sessionId: The call's 8x8 id, as 'Make voice call' gave it
output.sessionStatus: How it ended: COMPLETED, NO_ANSWER, BUSY, CANCELED, FAILED or ERROR

eight_by_eight_call_not_completed_trigge.description: Runs when a voice call isn't answered, is busy, is canceled or fails. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.callCount: How many call legs it had
output.details: Each call leg (callA and so on): numbers, direction, status, duration and quality
output.errorDetails: What went wrong, for an error: errorMsg and errorCode
output.lastAction: The last step of the call, such as SAY or PLAY_FILE
output.sessionId: The call's 8x8 id, as 'Make voice call' gave it
output.sessionStatus: How it ended: COMPLETED, NO_ANSWER, BUSY, CANCELED, FAILED or ERROR

eight_by_eight_chat_message_failed_trigg.description: Runs when a messaging app message you sent can't be delivered or is rejected, with the reason. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.batchId: The batch's id, for a batch
output.channel: The channel it went by, such as WhatsApp
output.status: Its status: state (queued, sent, delivered, read, undelivered or rejected), detail, errorCode, errorMessage and timestamp
output.subAccountId: The subaccount it was sent from
output.user: Who it was sent to: msisdn and channelUserId
output.whatsapp: WhatsApp's details: providerErrorCode, pricingCategory and templateId

eight_by_eight_chat_message_read_trigger.description: Runs when the person reads a messaging app message you sent. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.batchId: The batch's id, for a batch

output.status: Its status: state (queued, sent, delivered, read, undelivered or rejected), detail, errorCode, errorMessage and timestamp

eight_by_eight_chat_message_received_tri.description: Runs when someone messages one of your WhatsApp, Viber, LINE or other messaging app channels. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.content: The message: text, url of a file, a button's payload, location or interactive reply
output.recipient: Your channel it reached: channel (such as WhatsApp) and channelId
output.replyToUmid: The id of your message it answers, when it is a reply
output.subAccountId: The subaccount whose channel received it
output.type: What kind of message: Text, Image, Video, Audio, File, Location, Buttons, Interactive...
output.user: Who sent it: msisdn (phone number), channelUserId, name and username

eight_by_eight_chat_message_status_chang.description: Runs each time a messaging app message you sent changes status: queued, sent, delivered, read or failed. 8x8 tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.
